# hibira_push (Resource)

Push notifications for a Hibira app: turns on the app's Beams-compatible push instance and sets its Apple (APNs) and Firebase (FCM) credentials. Web push needs no credentials. Destroying it deletes the instance and every registered device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_push" "chat" {
  app_id = hibira_app.chat.id

  apns = {
    key_id      = "ABC123DEFG"
    team_id     = "TEAM123456"
    bundle_id   = "com.example.chat"
    private_key = file("AuthKey_ABC123DEFG.p8")
  }

  fcm = {
    service_account = file("firebase-service-account.json")
  }
}

output "beams_instance_id" {
  value = hibira_push.chat.instance_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app's ID.

### Optional

- `apns` (Attributes) A token-based (.p8) APNs signing key, for iOS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apns))
- `fcm` (Attributes) A Firebase service account, for Android. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fcm))

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) The push API base URL to configure in the Beams SDKs.
- `id` (String) The app ID.
- `instance_id` (String) The push instance ID (`instanceId` in the Beams SDKs).
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The push instance's secret key, for publishing from your server.
- `vapid_public_key` (String) The Web Push VAPID public key.

<a id="nestedatt--apns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apns`

Required:

- `bundle_id` (String) The app's bundle identifier (the default `apns-topic`).
- `key_id` (String) The 10-character key ID from the Apple Developer portal.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The .p8 file's contents, for example `file("AuthKey_ABC123DEFG.p8")`.
- `team_id` (String) The 10-character Apple team ID.

Optional:

- `environment` (String) `production` (default) or `development`.


<a id="nestedatt--fcm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fcm`

Required:

- `service_account` (String, Sensitive) The service account JSON file's contents, for example `file("firebase-service-account.json")`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Private keys aren't readable after import; the next apply sets the
# configured apns and fcm credentials again.
terraform import hibira_push.chat app_123
```
